title: Distance and Estimation
description: Understanding distance through travel stories and route estimation
learningObjectives: Estimate distances in practical situations
Compare journeys and calculate distances
Pay attention to estimation skills for word problems

title: Routes and Journeys
description: Comparing journeys and calculating distances between routes
learningObjectives: Compare different journeys and routes
Calculate distances in practical situations
Understand the concept of estimation in travel

title: Understanding Angles
description: Introducing angles using the idea of turns instead of degrees
learningObjectives: Understand angles as turns (full, half, quarter turns)
Distinguish between different types of turns
Build the base for geometry-related questions

title: Shape Properties
description: Learning about different shapes and their properties
learningObjectives: Identify different 2D shapes
Count sides and corners of shapes
Understand basic shape classification

title: Counting Squares
description: Learning how to count squares in various shapes
learningObjectives: Count the number of squares in a shape
Understand area as counting unit squares
differentiate between small and large squares

title: Understanding Fractions
description: Fractions as parts of a whole through pictures and daily-life examples
learningObjectives: Understand halves and quarters as parts of a whole
Identify proper and improper fractions
Perform simple fraction operations with visual aids

title: Lines of Symmetry
description: Identifying lines of symmetry in designs and shapes
learningObjectives: Identify lines of symmetry in 2D shapes
Fold shapes to find lines of symmetry
Create symmetrical designs

title: Multiples and Factors
description: Learning about multiples and factors through the game concept
learningObjectives: Identify multiples of a given number
Find factors of a given number
Understand the relationship between multiples and factors

title: Number and Shape Patterns
learningObjectives: Recognize and extend patterns in numbers and shapes
Create own patterns following a rule
Identify the core unit of a pattern

title: Map Directions and Symbols
description: Reading maps using symbols and understanding directions
learningObjectives: Read and interpret map symbols
Understand cardinal directions (N, S, E, W)
Follow routes on a map logically

title: 3D Shapes and Nets
description: Exploring different shapes and repeating patterns in 3D
learningObjectives: Identify 3D shapes (cubes, cuboids)
Understand faces, edges, and vertices
Create nets for 3D shapes

title: Tenths and Hundredths
description: Understanding decimal fractions and place value
learningObjectives: Convert fractions to decimal form (tenths/hundredths)
Understand place value in decimal numbers
Compare decimal numbers

title: Area and Boundary
description: Measuring area using a basic unit and comparing areas
learningObjectives: Concept of measurement using a basic unit
Find area of a square, rectangle, triangle
Understand area between two rectangles

title: Data Representation
description: Introducing data handling using pictographs and charts
learningObjectives: Collect and organise data
Create and interpret pictographs
Create and interpret simple bar charts

title: Multiplication and Division Methods
learningObjectives: Solve multiplication problems using grouping
Understand division as repeated subtraction
Apply multiplication in real-life contexts (farm scenarios)

title: Weight and Capacity
description: Measuring weight and capacity using standard units
learningObjectives: Measure weight in kilograms and grams
Measure capacity in litres and millilitres
Convert between different units of weight and capacity

title: Data Through Pictures
description: Final data handling chapter with pictographs and charts
learningObjectives: Collect and organise information visually
Interpret data from pictographs and charts
Draw conclusions from visual data representation
